note: Sample 1 (British Parliamentary), first speech: the Levin (2025) study of whether 16-year-olds are mature enough to vote linked to the journal's page at tandfonline.com, which stays behind a Cloudflare check. It now links the author's open preprint of the same paper on APSA Preprints. Its source line also named the wrong journal (the study appeared in the Journal of Elections, Public Opinion and Parties), so the line now names APSA Preprints.

Sample 2 (Policy), first and second speech: the Senate Commerce Committee's February 2026 report on California high-speed rail linked to commerce.senate.gov, which answers Access Denied. It now links the Internet Archive's copy of the same report. The case's wording did not change.
